name: Image Field 360
description: A field formatter that renders an image field as an interactive, drag-to-explore 360 degree panorama via the Photo Sphere Viewer library.
project_description: Image Field 360 adds a single field formatter ("Image field 360") for core image fields that renders each image as an interactive 360 degree panorama the visitor can drag to look around, zoom, and view fullscreen. Rendering is done client-side by the Photo Sphere Viewer JavaScript library written by Jeremy Heleine, which is NOT bundled with the module: you must download it separately and place three.min.js and photo-sphere-viewer.min.js in /libraries/photo-sphere-viewer/. hook_requirements() reports an error on the status report until both files are present. Images must be true equirectangular (360x180) panoramas; ordinary flat photos will look distorted. All behaviour is configured per view mode on Manage Display (loading message, width, height, and an optional styleable navigation bar).
